verdict.rationale: The docs describe dedicated `extract_header`/`extract_footer` parameters that return separate header and footer fields. They also describe `include_blocks`, which returns paragraph-level blocks with structural labels in reading order, and Mistral claims strong handling of advanced layouts. One hands-on tester praised its PDF-to-markdown accuracy, but another reported a page returned as a single image instead of extracted text, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-column layout handling, footnote handling, and independent corroboration of correct reading order on complex layouts.
